description.value:
Critical damage bonus +4. Party SP capacity +1 per Elation ally, capped at +3. Spending SP adds +1 Elation damage per charge, capped at +4, until your next turn. Spending 4 SP in one turn grants party Elation damage +2 for 1 turn.

Equipment: Occupy the Light Cone slot; matching elation Path required.
